news.title: Ducks open the season with a 4-3 victory over the Golden Knights
news.ruTitle: Дакс открыли сезон победой над Голден Найтс со счетом 4:3.
news.description: — Leo Carlsson had a goal and an assist, Lukas Dostal made 27 saves and the Anaheim Ducks opened the season by holding off the Vegas Golden Knights 4-3 on Friday night.

news.title: Mason McTavish scores right away in Blues debut in a 4-0 opening-night win over Stars
news.ruTitle: Мейсон Мактавиш сразу же забивает гол в дебютном матче «синих» в матче открытия над «Старз» со счетом 4:0.
news.description: — Mason McTavish scored only 94 seconds into his first game with the Blues to put them ahead to stay, Joel Hofer stopped 25 shots for his ninth career shutout and St. Louis won 4-0 at...

news.title: Blues' Alexey Toropchenko leaves opener with apparent shoulder injury
news.ruTitle: Игрок «синих» Алексей Торопченко покинул первый матч из-за явной травмы плеча.
news.description: St. Louis Blues forward Alexey Toropchenko has exited the season-opening game at Dallas with an apparent shoulder injury.

news.title: JJ Peterka scores in OT to lift the Bruins past the Jets, 4-3
news.ruTitle: Джей Джей Петерка забивает в овертайме и выводит «Брюинз» за пределы «Джетс» со счетом 4–3.
news.description: — Elias Lindholm tied it on a tip with 1:38 left in regulation and JJ Peterka scored at 3:21 of overtime to give the Boston Bruins a 4-3 victory over the Winnipeg Jets on Friday night.

news.title: Tuch scores twice in his first game for Washington, helping the Capitals beat the Hurricanes 5-2
news.ruTitle: Тач забивает дважды в своей первой игре за «Вашингтон», помогая «Кэпиталз» обыграть «Харрикейнз» со счетом 5–2.
news.description: — Alex Tuch scored twice in his first game for Washington, Alex Ovechkin opened his 22nd NHL season with an assist and the Capitals beat the Stanley Cup champion Carolina Hurricanes 5-2 on Friday night.

news.title: Dylan Garand makes 22 saves for 1st career shutout as Rangers beat Red Wings 2-0
news.ruTitle: Дилан Гаранд сделал 22 сейва и стал первым в карьере закрытым матчем, когда «Рейнджерс» обыграли «Ред Уингз» со счетом 2:0.
news.description: — Dylan Garand made 22 saves for his first career shutout and the New York Rangers spoiled the Detroit Red Wings' opener with a 2-0 victory on Friday.

news.title: ASU asks ex-state justice to lead review of hockey player's collapse
news.ruTitle: ASU просит бывшего судью штата провести расследование по делу о падении хоккеиста
news.description: Arizona State has asked a former chief justice of the Arizona Supreme Court to lead an independent review of the collapse of hockey player Matthew Mayich during an outdoor workout in August.

news.title: Penguins' Kuzmenko to wear No. 62 to honor dad killed in bear attack
news.ruTitle: Кузьменко из «Пингвинз» наденет 62-й номер в честь отца, погибшего при нападении медведя
news.description: Penguins forward Andrei Kuzmenko will change his jersey number to 62 in honor of his father, who was killed in a bear attack in Russia last week at age 62.

news.title: Larkin off to IR, booed loudly by Red Wings fans before loss
news.ruTitle: Ларкин отправился в IR, перед поражением его громко освистали фанаты «Ред Уингз»
news.description: As they continue to mull his trade request, the Detroit Red Wings moved Dylan Larkin to a non-roster injured reserve spot before Friday's 2-0 loss to the New York Rangers, a game the former captain was booed loudly in when he was shown on the video board.

news.title: PWHL adds 6-team conferences, quarterfinal playoff round
news.ruTitle: PWHL добавляет конференции с участием 6 команд и четвертьфинальный раунд плей-офф
news.description: The PWHL's addition of four teams is translating into more games, an expanded playoff format and two six-team conferences as the league enters its fourth season.

news.title: Goalie goals in NHL history: Shesterkin joins the list
news.ruTitle: Вратарские голы в истории НХЛ: Шестеркин пополнил список
news.description: Igor Shesterkin of the New York Rangers is the latest NHL goalie to score a goal. See which other players are on the list.

news.title: NHL Tonight: Capitals face Hurricanes in a critical early-season clash
news.ruTitle: НХЛ сегодня вечером: «Кэпиталз» сразятся с «Харрикейнз» в решающем поединке в начале сезона
news.description: Both are expected to challenge for the Metro Division title. Plus, what to watch in the other four games, updated stat leaders and more.
